Name: Penny Expansion
Author: LucyTheDove
Description:
[b]Enjoying this mod?[/b] Consider scrolling up and clicking the [b]endorse [/b]button, it goes a long way and helps the mod grow! 💝


[b]Features:[/b]

💬 100+ new dialogue lines for Penny and Pam
📜 23 new quests that expand their stories
🎉 4 cute heart events
🔍 Designed to blend naturally into vanilla gameplay
📝 Fully compatible with existing dialogue and quest mods
🧭 Balanced for a smooth, lore-friendly experience


[b]🧰 Installation:[/b]

This mod is ready to go right out of the box, while also compatible with any existing save of Stardew Valley 1.6+
No new save needed, simply drag and drop it into your Mods folder.

Steps:
[left]
[list]
[*]Download and extract the mod’s .zip file[/*]
[*]Place the folder inside Stardew Valley/Mods[/*]
[*]Make sure you have SMAPI installed (required for mods)[/*]
[*]Launch the game
[/*]
[/list][/left]
📚 [b]Information:[/b]

Quests, can be found in the [b]Guide[/b] at the[i][b] bottom of the[/b] [b]page[/b][/i], [i]scroll down to check it out![/i]


[b]⚓ Compatibility:[/b]

[i]Built with compatibility in mind, designed to work smoothly alongside other mods.[/i]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded[/*]
[*]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/*]
[*]Diverse Stardew Valley [/*]
[*]Peeny Everafter[/*]
[*]Miihau's Penny Expansion[/*]
[*]Simple Penny Expanded[/*]
[*]Pilot Penny[/*]
[*]Rival Hearts[/*]
[*]MaruxPenny Rival Events Revived[/*]
[*]Ridgeside Village[/*]
[*]East Scarp[/*]
[/list]No known compatibility issues, this mod adds dialogue and quests without altering core logic and closely follows vanilla behavior, ensuring easy compatibility. Feel free to reach out with questions or for collaboration! 🧡


[b]🌎 Translations:
[/b]
If you’d like to contribute a translation, or correct an existing one, then message me on Nexus before you publish it. Starting now, all translations will be handled by the respected translators, on their own mod translation page. 💙

[u][b]AI is strictly prohibited[/b][/u]. Code, sprites, and similar generated by these models are not ever accepted[i]. This policy is in place indefinitely and is not subject to change. [/i]🔒


[b]❓ Q&A

Q:[/b] What if I’m already in Year 3+?
[b]A:[/b] All quests and letters will be safe and accessible.

[b]Q:[/b] Does this support Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion?
[b]A: Yes! [/b]It has full integration and support.

[b]Q:[/b] How can I do a specific quest?
[b]A:[/b] Scroll down to the bottom of the page to see how it can be activated!


🤝 [b]Contributing[/b]

[b]Want to contribute?[/b] Feel free to contribute [b]sprites[/b], [b]code[/b], [b]ideas[/b], and more!
Feel free to reach out on Nexus or Discord [i]if you’d like to get involved[/i]. 🧡
